description: Issue #867 (PR #884 cross-vendor review fix): same patch and same target line as wtmsec867-gateway-type-guard-neutralize (`if (IsBannedGatewayType(memberType)) return BindingRejectionReason.GatewayType;`, src/WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core/Helper/RequestBindingPolicy.cs -- now inside Classify, per Issue #1080's refactor; IsPathAllowed(Type, string, string) is a pure delegation, `Classify(...) == BindingRejectionReason.None`), verified from the OTHER test project against the five specific bypass shapes the review named -- an alias property, new-shadowing, an interface-typed member, an intermediate base class, and a closed generic type parameter. The version of this policy that first shipped in PR #884 checked member.DeclaringType plus a curated name set; every one of these five shapes changes the resolved member's name or declaring class away from what that check recognised, while leaving the resolved TYPE (Configs, in every fixture) unchanged -- so all five sailed through the original check and only the type-based rewrite catches them. RequestBindingPolicyTests867.IsPathAllowed_AliasProperty_ReturnsFalse / IsPathAllowed_NewShadowedConfigInfo_ReturnsFalse / IsPathAllowed_InterfaceTypedGatewayAlias_ReturnsFalse / IsPathAllowed_AliasOnIntermediateBaseClass_ReturnsFalse / IsPathAllowed_GenericTypeParameterClosedOverConfigs_ReturnsFalse each build exactly one shape and assert IsPathAllowed returns false; with the type guard neutralized, Classify returns BindingRejectionReason.None for all five (Configs is reachable) and IsPathAllowed's delegation therefore returns true instead of false, which is what turns each assertion red. The green control, IsPathAllowed_SearcherDotCustomFilterField_ReturnsTrue, exercises a legitimate non-gateway-typed Searcher.ZipCode path and is genuinely unaffected by this mutant.
target_symbol: RequestBindingPolicy.Classify(Type, string, string) -- the `if (IsBannedGatewayType(memberType)) return BindingRejectionReason.GatewayType;` guard condition (IsPathAllowed is now a pure delegation to Classify, per Issue #1080)

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core.Test.Helper.Request: 'Settings' is declared on AliasVM, not BaseVM, and named nothing the old policy recognised
'ConfigInfo' declared with 'new' on ShadowVM resolves \(as the sole, most-derived member\) to type Configs
'Ctx' is declared on InterfaceTypedVM and resolves to the INTERFACE type IDataContext
'Gateway' is declared on the OPEN generic GenericGatewayBase<TGateway>

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Re-captured verbatim (issue #1080 refactor: patch retargeted from IsPathAllowed to Classify) against a clean checkout with the regenerated mutant patch applied (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first): IsPathAllowed_AliasProperty_ReturnsFalse -> "Assert.IsFalse failed. #867/PR#884 review shape 1 (alias property): 'Settings' is declared on AliasVM, not BaseVM, and named nothing the old policy recognised — but it resolves to type Configs, so the gateway-TYPE check must still reject it."; IsPathAllowed_NewShadowedConfigInfo_ReturnsFalse -> "Assert.IsFalse failed. #867/PR#884 review shape 2 (new-shadowing): 'ConfigInfo' declared with 'new' on ShadowVM resolves (as the sole, most-derived member) to type Configs, a banned gateway type — the gateway-TYPE check must reject it."; IsPathAllowed_InterfaceTypedGatewayAlias_ReturnsFalse -> "Assert.IsFalse failed. #867/PR#884 review shape 3 (interface-typed member): 'Ctx' is declared on InterfaceTypedVM and resolves to the INTERFACE type IDataContext (not a concrete class) — the gateway-type check must still reject it via IsAssignableFrom, not exact-type equality."; IsPathAllowed_AliasOnIntermediateBaseClass_ReturnsFalse -> "Assert.IsFalse failed. #867/PR#884 review shape 4 (intermediate base class): 'InheritedSettings' is declared on IntermediateBaseVM — neither BaseVM nor the concrete leaf type — but resolves to type Configs, so the gateway-type check must still reject it regardless of which class in the hierarchy declares it."; IsPathAllowed_GenericTypeParameterClosedOverConfigs_ReturnsFalse -> "Assert.IsFalse failed. #867/PR#884 review shape 5 (generic type parameter): 'Gateway' is declared on the OPEN generic GenericGatewayBase<TGateway>, but ConcreteGenericVM closes TGateway over Configs — member.GetMemberType() resolves the SUBSTITUTED closed type (Configs), not the open parameter, so the gateway-type check must still reject it.". Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant wtmsec867-gateway-type-guard-neutralize-shapes: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS' (all five listed as failed with expected assertion message in the same run).
